mapper.select: SELECT decision.recognition_id AS recognitionId, decision.company_id AS companyId, decision.employee_id AS employeeId, decision.attendance_source_id AS sourceId, decision.source_business_key AS sourceBusinessKey, decision.source_version AS sourceVersion, decision.oa_attendance_document_id AS documentId, decision.business_date AS businessDate, decision.expected_interval_start AS expectedIntervalStart, decision.expected_interval_end AS expectedIntervalEnd, decision.overtime_type AS overtimeType, decision.recognized_minutes AS recognizedMinutes, decision.knowledge_at AS knowledgeAt, decision.reversed_at AS reversedAt, decision.user_confirmation_sha256 AS confirmationSha256, decision.evidence_sha256 AS evidenceSha256, decision.request_id AS requestId FROM attendance_report_oa_overtime_recognition decision JOIN oa_attendance_document document ON document.oa_attendance_document_id = decision.oa_attendance_document_id AND document.attendance_source_id = decision.attendance_source_id AND document.source_business_key = decision.source_business_key AND document.source_version = decision.source_version WHERE decision.company_id = #{companyId} AND decision.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND decision.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} AND decision.knowledge_at <= #{dataAsOf} ORDER BY decision.recognition_id

SELECT exclusion.exclusion_id AS exclusionId, exclusion.company_id AS companyId, exclusion.employee_id AS employeeId, exclusion.attendance_source_id AS sourceId, exclusion.source_business_key AS sourceBusinessKey, exclusion.source_version AS sourceVersion, exclusion.oa_attendance_document_id AS documentId, document.document_type AS documentType, normalized.interval_start AS intervalStart, normalized.interval_end AS intervalEnd, normalized.point_instant AS pointInstant, exclusion.knowledge_at AS knowledgeAt, exclusion.reversed_at AS reversedAt, exclusion.user_confirmation_sha256 AS confirmationSha256, exclusion.evidence_sha256 AS evidenceSha256, exclusion.request_id AS requestId FROM attendance_report_oa_evidence_exclusion exclusion JOIN oa_attendance_document document ON document.oa_attendance_document_id = exclusion.oa_attendance_document_id AND document.attendance_source_id = exclusion.attendance_source_id AND document.source_business_key = exclusion.source_business_key AND document.source_version = exclusion.source_version JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = document.normalized_attendance_record_id WHERE exclusion.company_id = #{companyId} AND exclusion.knowledge_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND ( (normalized.interval_start IS NOT NULL AND normalized.interval_start < #{windowEndExclusive} AND normalized.interval_end > #{windowStart}) OR (normalized.point_instant IS NOT NULL AND normalized.point_instant >= #{windowStart} AND normalized.point_instant < #{windowEndExclusive}) ) ORDER BY exclusion.exclusion_id

SELECT DISTINCT marker.version_marker FROM attendance_report_projection projection CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(projection.source_versions_json, '$[*]' COLUMNS (version_marker VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')) marker WHERE projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND projection.projection_version = #{projectionVersion} AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND marker.version_marker LIKE 'DECISION.OT:%' ORDER BY marker.version_marker

SELECT DISTINCT marker.version_marker FROM attendance_report_projection projection CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(projection.source_versions_json, '$[*]' COLUMNS (version_marker VARCHAR(255) PATH '$')) marker WHERE projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND projection.projection_version = #{projectionVersion} AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND marker.version_marker LIKE 'DECISION.EXCLUSION:%' ORDER BY marker.version_marker

SELECT projection_version AS projectionVersion, data_as_of AS dataAsOf, period_state AS periodState FROM attendance_report_projection WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND period_start = #{periodStart} AND period_end_exclusive = #{periodEndExclusive} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND formula_catalog_version = 'FULL_CALCULATION_OA_FORM_HOURS_V8' ORDER BY published_at DESC, attendance_report_projection_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(original.attendance_source_id, ':', original.source_business_key) FROM oa_attendance_document original JOIN normalized_attendance_record original_interval ON original_interval.normalized_attendance_record_id = original.normalized_attendance_record_id JOIN employee_match_decision original_match ON original_match.normalized_attendance_record_id = original.normalized_attendance_record_id AND original_match.match_status = 'MATCHED'
AND original_match.employee_id IN
#{eid}
JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = original_match.employee_id AND employee.company_id = #{companyId} JOIN oa_attendance_document amendment ON amendment.attendance_source_id = original.attendance_source_id AND amendment.document_type = 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' AND amendment.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} JOIN normalized_attendance_record amendment_interval ON amendment_interval.normalized_attendance_record_id = amendment.normalized_attendance_record_id JOIN employee_match_decision amendment_match ON amendment_match.normalized_attendance_record_id = amendment.normalized_attendance_record_id AND amendment_match.match_status = 'MATCHED' AND amendment_match.employee_id = original_match.employee_id WHERE original.document_type = 'LEAVE' AND original.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND ( (original_interval.interval_start < #{windowEndExclusive} AND original_interval.interval_end > #{windowStart}) OR (amendment_interval.interval_start < #{windowEndExclusive} AND amendment_interval.interval_end > #{windowStart}) OR (amendment_interval.point_instant >= #{windowStart} AND amendment_interval.point_instant < #{windowEndExclusive}) ) AND ( (NULLIF(TRIM(amendment.original_leave_serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(original.leave_serial) = TRIM(amendment.original_leave_serial)) OR (NULLIF(TRIM(amendment.original_leave_serial), '') IS NULL AND COALESCE(amendment_interval.interval_start, amendment_interval.point_instant) <= original_interval.interval_end AND COALESCE(amendment_interval.interval_end, amendment_interval.point_instant) >= original_interval.interval_start) )

SELECT document.source_business_key AS sourceBusinessKey, fact.document_type AS documentType, CASE WHEN fact.document_type = 'OVERTIME' THEN CASE WHEN fact.leave_type_code IN ('PAID', 'COMPENSATORY', 'VOLUNTARY') THEN fact.leave_type_code ELSE NULL END ELSE NULL END AS overtimeType, CASE WHEN fact.document_type IN ('LEAVE', 'TIME_OFF') THEN fact.leave_type_code ELSE NULL END AS leaveType, employee.employee_number AS employeeNumber, COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant) AS startInstant, COALESCE(fact.interval_end, fact.point_instant) AS endInstant, 'Asia/Shanghai' AS sourceTimeZone, document.first_submitted_at AS firstSubmittedAt, CASE WHEN fact.document_type <> 'OVERTIME' THEN TRUE WHEN fact.leave_type_code IN ('PAID', 'COMPENSATORY', 'VOLUNTARY') AND COALESCE(daily.recognized_overtime_minutes, 0) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS effectiveCandidate, document.leave_serial AS leaveSerial, document.original_leave_serial AS originalLeaveSerial, document.attendance_source_id AS sourceId, fact.employee_id AS employeeId FROM attendance_report_projection projection JOIN attendance_report_oa_fact fact ON fact.attendance_report_projection_id = projection.attendance_report_projection_id AND fact.company_id = projection.company_id
AND 1 = 0
AND fact.employee_id IN
#{scopedEmployeeId}
JOIN oa_attendance_document document ON document.oa_attendance_document_id = fact.oa_attendance_document_id JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = fact.employee_id LEFT JOIN attendance_report_daily_fact daily ON daily.attendance_report_projection_id = projection.attendance_report_projection_id AND daily.employee_id = fact.employee_id AND daily.business_date = DATE(TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, 8, COALESCE(fact.interval_start, fact.point_instant))) WHERE projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND projection.projection_version = #{projectionVersion} AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY document.source_business_key, fact.interval_start

SELECT document.attendance_source_id AS sourceId, document.source_business_key AS sourceBusinessKey, fact.employee_id AS employeeId, fact.recognized_minutes AS recognizedMinutes, fact.recognized_minutes_by_date_json AS recognizedMinutesByDateJson FROM attendance_report_projection projection JOIN attendance_report_oa_fact fact ON fact.attendance_report_projection_id = projection.attendance_report_projection_id AND fact.company_id = projection.company_id AND fact.document_type = 'LEAVE' JOIN oa_attendance_document document ON document.oa_attendance_document_id = fact.oa_attendance_document_id WHERE projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND projection.projection_version = #{projectionVersion} AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY document.attendance_source_id, document.source_business_key, fact.employee_id
mapper.sql:
OR ( oa.document_type = 'LEAVE' AND NULLIF(TRIM(oa.leave_serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ranked_document amendment JOIN normalized_attendance_record amendment_interval ON amendment_interval.normalized_attendance_record_id = amendment.normalized_attendance_record_id AND amendment_interval.validation_status = 'VALID' JOIN employee_match_decision amendment_match ON amendment_match.normalized_attendance_record_id = amendment.normalized_attendance_record_id AND amendment_match.match_status = 'MATCHED' WHERE amendment.version_rank = 1
AND amendment.document_type = 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' AND amendment.effective_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED') AND amendment.attendance_source_id = oa.attendance_source_id AND amendment_match.employee_id = match_decision.employee_id AND TRIM(amendment.original_leave_serial) = TRIM(oa.leave_serial) AND ( (amendment_interval.interval_start < #{windowEndExclusive} AND amendment_interval.interval_end > #{windowStart}) OR (amendment_interval.point_instant >= #{windowStart} AND amendment_interval.point_instant < #{windowEndExclusive}) ) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT source.attendance_source_id AS source_id, source.source_type, source.row_version AS source_row_version, COALESCE(configuration.revision_number, 0) AS configuration_revision, watermark.row_version AS watermark_row_version, watermark.committed_page_digest, watermark.committed_at FROM attendance_source source LEFT JOIN attendance_source_config_revision configuration ON configuration.source_config_revision_id = ( SELECT candidate.source_config_revision_id FROM attendance_source_config_revision candidate WHERE candidate.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id AND candidate.effective_from <= #{dataAsOf} AND candidate.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} ORDER BY candidate.revision_number DESC, candidate.source_config_revision_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN attendance_sync_watermark watermark ON watermark.attendance_source_id = source.attendance_source_id AND watermark.committed_at <= #{dataAsOf} WHERE source.status = 'ACTIVE' AND source.source_type IN ('DELI_CLOUD', 'OA_ATTENDANCE') AND source.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} ORDER BY source.source_type, source.attendance_source_id

SELECT employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, employment.assignment_id AS employment_assignment_id, organization.organization_id, organization_version.organization_version_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, employee_version.effective_from AS employee_version_from, employee_version.effective_to AS employee_version_to, DATE(employment.effective_from) AS employment_from, DATE(employment.effective_to) AS employment_to, DATE(organization_version.effective_from) AS organization_version_from, DATE(organization_version.effective_to) AS organization_version_to FROM employee employee JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{periodStart} ) JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(employment.effective_from) < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(employment.effective_to) > #{periodStart} ) JOIN organization_identity organization ON organization.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND organization.company_id = employee.company_id AND organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_id = organization.organization_id AND organization_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(organization_version.effective_from) < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( organization_version.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(organization_version.effective_to) > #{periodStart} ) WHERE employee.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employment.assignment_id, organization_version.organization_version_id

SELECT roster_employee.employee_id, event.point_instant FROM effective_attendance_event event JOIN employee roster_employee ON roster_employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND ( roster_employee.employee_id = event.employee_id OR roster_employee.employee_number = ( SELECT punch_employee.employee_number FROM employee punch_employee WHERE punch_employee.employee_id = event.employee_id ) ) WHERE event.event_kind = 'PUNCH_POINT' AND event.point_instant IS NOT NULL AND event.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND event.point_instant >= #{windowStart} AND event.point_instant < #{windowEndExclusive} AND ( SELECT lifecycle.lifecycle_type FROM effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle WHERE lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id AND lifecycle.knowledge_at <= #{dataAsOf} ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at DESC, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'ACTIVATED' ORDER BY event.employee_id, event.point_instant

SELECT correction.punch_correction_request_id AS requestId, correction.employee_id AS employeeId, correction.business_date AS businessDate, correction.punch_side AS punchSide, correction.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM punch_correction_request correction JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = correction.employee_id AND employee.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE correction.status = 'APPROVED' AND correction.reviewed_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND correction.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND correction.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} ORDER BY correction.employee_id, correction.business_date, correction.punch_correction_request_id

SELECT adjustment.adjustment_id AS adjustmentId, adjustment.employee_id AS employeeId, adjustment.business_date AS businessDate, adjustment.on_duty_at AS onDutyAt, adjustment.off_duty_at AS offDutyAt, adjustment.created_at AS createdAt, adjustment.overtime_minutes_override AS overtimeMinutesOverride, adjustment.cleared_exception_types AS clearedExceptionTypes, adjustment.day_types AS dayTypes FROM attendance_hr_punch_adjustment adjustment WHERE adjustment.company_id = #{companyId} AND adjustment.reversed_at IS NULL AND adjustment.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND adjustment.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND adjustment.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} ORDER BY adjustment.employee_id, adjustment.business_date, adjustment.created_at

SELECT roster_employee.employee_id AS employeeId, assignment.valid_from AS validFrom, assignment.valid_to AS validTo FROM employee roster_employee JOIN employee role_employee ON role_employee.employee_number = roster_employee.employee_number JOIN auth_principal principal ON principal.employee_id = role_employee.employee_id JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment assignment ON assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role role ON role.role_id = assignment.role_id AND role.role_code = 'EXECUTIVE' WHERE roster_employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND ( assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{windowStart} ) ORDER BY roster_employee.employee_id, assignment.valid_from

SELECT roster_employee.employee_id AS employeeId, assignment.valid_from AS validFrom, assignment.valid_to AS validTo FROM punch_exemption_assignment assignment JOIN employee listed_employee ON listed_employee.employee_id = assignment.employee_id JOIN employee roster_employee ON roster_employee.employee_number = listed_employee.employee_number WHERE roster_employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND assignment.source = 'STANDING_LIST' AND ( assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{windowStart} ) ORDER BY roster_employee.employee_id, assignment.valid_from

SELECT identity.organization_id AS organizationId, version.parent_organization_id AS parentOrganizationId, version.name AS name, version.org_type AS orgType FROM organization_identity identity JOIN organization_current_projection projection ON projection.organization_id = identity.organization_id JOIN organization_version version ON version.organization_version_id = projection.current_version_id AND version.organization_id = identity.organization_id AND version.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE identity.company_id = #{companyId} AND identity.identity_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT closure.descendant_organization_id AS organizationId, version.name AS ancestorName, version.org_type AS ancestorOrgType, closure.depth AS depth FROM organization_current_closure closure JOIN organization_identity descendant ON descendant.organization_id = closure.descendant_organization_id AND descendant.company_id = #{companyId} AND descendant.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_identity ancestor ON ancestor.organization_id = closure.ancestor_organization_id AND ancestor.company_id = #{companyId} JOIN organization_current_projection projection ON projection.organization_id = ancestor.organization_id JOIN organization_version version ON version.organization_version_id = projection.current_version_id AND version.organization_id = ancestor.organization_id AND version.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY closure.descendant_organization_id ASC, closure.depth DESC

WITH ranked_document AS ( SELECT document.*, CASE WHEN document.source_status = 'UNKNOWN' AND document.source_version REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])T([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]{1,9})?:state=0:Asia/Shanghai$' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE document.source_status END AS effective_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY document.attendance_source_id, document.source_business_key ORDER BY document.knowledge_rank DESC, document.created_at DESC, document.oa_attendance_document_id DESC ) AS version_rank FROM oa_attendance_document document WHERE document.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} ) SELECT oa.source_business_key AS sourceBusinessKey, oa.document_type AS documentType, context.overtime_type AS overtimeType, oa.leave_type AS leaveType, employee.employee_number AS employeeNumber, COALESCE(normalized.interval_start, normalized.point_instant) AS startInstant, COALESCE(normalized.interval_end, normalized.point_instant) AS endInstant, raw.source_time_zone AS sourceTimeZone, oa.first_submitted_at AS firstSubmittedAt, TRUE AS effectiveCandidate, oa.leave_serial AS leaveSerial, oa.original_leave_serial AS originalLeaveSerial, oa.attendance_source_id AS sourceId, employee.employee_id AS employeeId FROM ranked_document oa JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = oa.normalized_attendance_record_id AND normalized.validation_status = 'VALID' JOIN raw_attendance_fact raw ON raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = normalized.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN employee_match_decision match_decision ON match_decision.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id AND match_decision.match_status = 'MATCHED' JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = match_decision.employee_id LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_document_context context ON context.oa_attendance_document_id = oa.oa_attendance_document_id WHERE oa.version_rank = 1
AND oa.effective_status IN ( 'APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED', 'PENDING') AND oa.document_type <> 'TRIP' AND (oa.document_type <> 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' OR oa.effective_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED')) AND ( ( normalized.interval_start < #{windowEndExclusive} AND normalized.interval_end > #{windowStart} ) OR ( oa.document_type = 'PUNCH_CORRECTION' AND COALESCE( normalized.interval_start, normalized.point_instant) >= #{windowStart} AND COALESCE( normalized.interval_start, normalized.point_instant) < #{windowEndExclusive} ) OR ( oa.document_type = 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' AND NULLIF(TRIM(oa.original_leave_serial), '') IS NULL AND normalized.point_instant > #{windowStart} AND normalized.point_instant < #{windowEndExclusive} ) OR ( oa.document_type = 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' AND oa.effective_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED') AND NULLIF(TRIM(oa.original_leave_serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ranked_document original JOIN normalized_attendance_record original_interval ON original_interval.normalized_attendance_record_id = original.normalized_attendance_record_id AND original_interval.validation_status = 'VALID' JOIN employee_match_decision original_match ON original_match.normalized_attendance_record_id = original.normalized_attendance_record_id AND original_match.match_status = 'MATCHED' WHERE original.version_rank = 1
AND original.document_type = 'LEAVE' AND original.effective_status IN ( 'APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED', 'PENDING') AND original.attendance_source_id = oa.attendance_source_id AND original_match.employee_id = match_decision.employee_id AND TRIM(original.leave_serial) = TRIM(oa.original_leave_serial) AND original_interval.interval_start < #{windowEndExclusive} AND original_interval.interval_end > #{windowStart} ) )
) AND ( oa.document_type <> 'OVERTIME' OR ( context.activation_decision = 'ACTIVATED' AND context.overtime_type IS NOT NULL ) ) ORDER BY employee.employee_number, normalized.interval_start, oa.source_business_key

SELECT fact.employee_id AS employeeId, COUNT(*) AS lateDays FROM attendance_report_daily_fact fact WHERE fact.attendance_report_projection_id = ( SELECT projection.attendance_report_projection_id FROM attendance_report_projection projection WHERE projection.company_id = #{companyId} AND projection.period_start = #{periodStart} AND projection.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY projection.published_at DESC, projection.attendance_report_projection_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND fact.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND fact.business_date < #{beforeDate} AND fact.late_minutes > 0 GROUP BY fact.employee_id

WITH ledger_effect AS ( SELECT entry.time_account_id, COALESCE(original.entry_type, entry.entry_type) AS semantic_type, COALESCE(original.amount_hours, entry.amount_hours) AS semantic_amount_hours, entry.amount_hours, entry.sequence_no FROM time_account_ledger_entry entry LEFT JOIN time_account_ledger_entry original ON entry.entry_type = 'REVERSAL' AND original.time_account_ledger_entry_id = entry.reversal_of_entry_id WHERE entry.occurred_at <= #{dataAsOf} ), ledger_totals AS ( SELECT time_account_id, COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) AS max_sequence, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'OPENING' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'GRANT' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS granted_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'OVERTIME_CREDIT' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overtime_credit_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND semantic_amount_hours > 0 THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS manual_increase_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND semantic_amount_hours < 0 THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS manual_deduction_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'USE' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS used_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'EXPIRY' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expired_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'RETURN' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returned_hours FROM ledger_effect GROUP BY time_account_id ) SELECT account.time_account_id AS accountId, account.employee_id AS employeeId, assignment.assignment_id AS employmentAssignmentId, CASE account.account_type WHEN 'ANNUAL_LEAVE' THEN 'ANNUAL_LEAVE' WHEN 'TIME_OFF' THEN 'COMP_TIME' WHEN 'WORK_HOURS' THEN 'RECOGNIZED_OVERTIME' END AS accountType, COALESCE(totals.opening_hours, 0) AS openingHours, COALESCE(totals.granted_hours, 0) AS grantedHours, COALESCE(totals.overtime_credit_hours, 0) AS overtimeCreditHours, COALESCE(totals.manual_increase_hours, 0) AS manualIncreaseHours, -COALESCE(totals.used_hours, 0) AS usedHours, -COALESCE(totals.expired_hours, 0) AS expiredHours, COALESCE(totals.returned_hours, 0) AS returnedHours, -COALESCE(totals.manual_deduction_hours, 0) AS manualDeductionHours, CONCAT( 'TIME_ACCOUNT:', account.time_account_id, ':ASOF:S', COALESCE(totals.max_sequence, 0) ) AS ledgerVersion FROM time_account account JOIN employment_assignment assignment ON assignment.employment_period_id = account.employment_period_id AND assignment.employee_id = account.employee_id AND assignment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND assignment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND assignment.effective_from < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > #{periodStart} ) LEFT JOIN ledger_totals totals ON totals.time_account_id = account.time_account_id WHERE account.company_id = #{companyId} AND account.account_year = YEAR(#{periodStart}) AND account.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} ORDER BY account.employee_id, account.account_type, account.time_account_id

WITH date_ones AS ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 ), period_business_dates AS ( SELECT DATE_ADD( CAST(#{periodStart} AS DATE), INTERVAL (ones.n + 10 * tens.n) DAY) AS business_date FROM date_ones ones CROSS JOIN date_ones tens WHERE (ones.n + 10 * tens.n) < 62 AND DATE_ADD( CAST(#{periodStart} AS DATE), INTERVAL (ones.n + 10 * tens.n) DAY) < #{periodEndExclusive} ), published_punch_windows AS ( SELECT DISTINCT version.scope_id, version.scoped_version_id, version.effective_from, version.effective_to, publication.business_effective_from, publication.event_sequence, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.arrivalBeforeMinutes')) AS UNSIGNED) AS arrival_before_minutes, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.arrivalAfterMinutes')) AS UNSIGNED) AS arrival_after_minutes, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.departureBeforeMinutes')) AS UNSIGNED) AS departure_before_minutes, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.departureAfterMinutes')) AS UNSIGNED) AS departure_after_minutes FROM attendance_policy_template template JOIN attendance_policy_scope policy_scope ON policy_scope.policy_template_id = template.policy_template_id AND policy_scope.company_id = #{companyId} AND policy_scope.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} JOIN attendance_policy_scoped_version version ON version.scope_id = policy_scope.scope_id AND version.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} JOIN attendance_policy_lifecycle_event publication ON publication.scope_id = version.scope_id AND publication.scoped_version_id = version.scoped_version_id AND publication.action = 'PUBLISHED' AND publication.recorded_at <= #{dataAsOf} WHERE template.template_code = 'PUNCH_WINDOW' AND template.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.enabled')) = 'BOOLEAN' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.enabled')) = 'true' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.arrivalBeforeMinutes')) = 'INTEGER' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.arrivalAfterMinutes')) = 'INTEGER' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.departureBeforeMinutes')) = 'INTEGER' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.departureAfterMinutes')) = 'INTEGER' AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.arrivalBeforeMinutes')) AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 0 AND 720 AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.arrivalAfterMinutes')) AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 0 AND 720 AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.departureBeforeMinutes')) AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 0 AND 720 AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( version.parameters_json, '$.departureAfterMinutes')) AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN 0 AND 720 ), valid_punch_window_policy AS ( SELECT DISTINCT business_date.business_date, windows.scoped_version_id, windows.arrival_before_minutes, windows.arrival_after_minutes, windows.departure_before_minutes, windows.departure_after_minutes FROM period_business_dates business_date JOIN published_punch_windows windows ON windows.effective_from <= business_date.business_date AND ( windows.effective_to IS NULL OR windows.effective_to > business_date.business_date ) AND windows.business_effective_from <= business_date.business_date WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_policy_lifecycle_event later WHERE later.scope_id = windows.scope_id AND later.event_sequence > windows.event_sequence AND later.business_effective_from <= business_date.business_date AND later.recorded_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND later.action IN ( 'DEACTIVATE_SCHEDULED', 'ROLLED_BACK') ) ), unique_punch_window_policy AS ( SELECT business_date, MIN(arrival_before_minutes) AS arrival_before_minutes, MIN(arrival_after_minutes) AS arrival_after_minutes, MIN(departure_before_minutes) AS departure_before_minutes, MIN(departure_after_minutes) AS departure_after_minutes FROM valid_punch_window_policy GROUP BY business_date HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ) SELECT business_date AS businessDate, arrival_before_minutes AS arrivalBeforeMinutes, arrival_after_minutes AS arrivalAfterMinutes, departure_before_minutes AS departureBeforeMinutes, departure_after_minutes AS departureAfterMinutes FROM unique_punch_window_policy ORDER BY business_date

SELECT employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, employment.assignment_id AS employment_assignment_id, organization.organization_id, organization_version.organization_version_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, employee_version.effective_from AS employee_version_from, employee_version.effective_to AS employee_version_to, DATE(employment.effective_from) AS employment_from, DATE(employment.effective_to) AS employment_to, DATE(organization_version.effective_from) AS organization_version_from, DATE(organization_version.effective_to) AS organization_version_to FROM employee employee JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{periodStart} ) JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(employment.effective_from) < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(employment.effective_to) > #{periodStart} ) JOIN organization_identity organization ON organization.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND organization.company_id = employee.company_id AND organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_id = organization.organization_id AND organization_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(organization_version.effective_from) < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( organization_version.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(organization_version.effective_to) > #{periodStart} ) WHERE employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND employee.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employment.assignment_id, organization_version.organization_version_id

SELECT correction.punch_correction_request_id AS requestId, correction.employee_id AS employeeId, correction.business_date AS businessDate, correction.punch_side AS punchSide, correction.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt FROM punch_correction_request correction JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = correction.employee_id AND employee.company_id = #{companyId} WHERE correction.status = 'APPROVED' AND correction.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND correction.reviewed_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND correction.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND correction.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} ORDER BY correction.employee_id, correction.business_date, correction.punch_correction_request_id

SELECT adjustment.adjustment_id AS adjustmentId, adjustment.employee_id AS employeeId, adjustment.business_date AS businessDate, adjustment.on_duty_at AS onDutyAt, adjustment.off_duty_at AS offDutyAt, adjustment.created_at AS createdAt, adjustment.overtime_minutes_override AS overtimeMinutesOverride, adjustment.cleared_exception_types AS clearedExceptionTypes, adjustment.day_types AS dayTypes FROM attendance_hr_punch_adjustment adjustment WHERE adjustment.company_id = #{companyId} AND adjustment.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND adjustment.reversed_at IS NULL AND adjustment.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND adjustment.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND adjustment.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} ORDER BY adjustment.employee_id, adjustment.business_date, adjustment.created_at

SELECT roster_employee.employee_id AS employeeId, assignment.valid_from AS validFrom, assignment.valid_to AS validTo FROM employee roster_employee JOIN employee role_employee ON role_employee.employee_number = roster_employee.employee_number JOIN auth_principal principal ON principal.employee_id = role_employee.employee_id JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment assignment ON assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role role ON role.role_id = assignment.role_id AND role.role_code = 'EXECUTIVE' WHERE roster_employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND roster_employee.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ( assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{windowStart} ) ORDER BY roster_employee.employee_id, assignment.valid_from

SELECT roster_employee.employee_id AS employeeId, assignment.valid_from AS validFrom, assignment.valid_to AS validTo FROM punch_exemption_assignment assignment JOIN employee listed_employee ON listed_employee.employee_id = assignment.employee_id JOIN employee roster_employee ON roster_employee.employee_number = listed_employee.employee_number WHERE roster_employee.company_id = #{companyId} AND roster_employee.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND assignment.source = 'STANDING_LIST' AND ( assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{windowStart} ) ORDER BY roster_employee.employee_id, assignment.valid_from

WITH ranked_document AS ( SELECT document.*, CASE WHEN document.source_status = 'UNKNOWN' AND document.source_version REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])T([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]{1,9})?:state=0:Asia/Shanghai$' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE document.source_status END AS effective_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY document.attendance_source_id, document.source_business_key ORDER BY document.knowledge_rank DESC, document.created_at DESC, document.oa_attendance_document_id DESC ) AS version_rank FROM oa_attendance_document document WHERE document.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oa_attendance_document employee_document JOIN employee_match_decision employee_match ON employee_match.normalized_attendance_record_id = employee_document.normalized_attendance_record_id WHERE employee_document.attendance_source_id = document.attendance_source_id AND employee_document.source_business_key = document.source_business_key AND employee_document.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND employee_match.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND employee_match.match_status = 'MATCHED' ) ) SELECT oa.source_business_key AS sourceBusinessKey, oa.document_type AS documentType, context.overtime_type AS overtimeType, oa.leave_type AS leaveType, employee.employee_number AS employeeNumber, COALESCE(normalized.interval_start, normalized.point_instant) AS startInstant, COALESCE(normalized.interval_end, normalized.point_instant) AS endInstant, raw.source_time_zone AS sourceTimeZone, oa.first_submitted_at AS firstSubmittedAt, TRUE AS effectiveCandidate, oa.leave_serial AS leaveSerial, oa.original_leave_serial AS originalLeaveSerial, oa.attendance_source_id AS sourceId, employee.employee_id AS employeeId FROM ranked_document oa JOIN normalized_attendance_record normalized ON normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id = oa.normalized_attendance_record_id AND normalized.validation_status = 'VALID' JOIN raw_attendance_fact raw ON raw.raw_attendance_fact_id = normalized.raw_attendance_fact_id JOIN employee_match_decision match_decision ON match_decision.normalized_attendance_record_id = normalized.normalized_attendance_record_id AND match_decision.match_status = 'MATCHED' AND match_decision.employee_id = #{employeeId} JOIN employee employee ON employee.employee_id = match_decision.employee_id LEFT JOIN oa_attendance_document_context context ON context.oa_attendance_document_id = oa.oa_attendance_document_id WHERE oa.version_rank = 1
AND oa.effective_status IN ( 'APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED', 'PENDING') AND oa.document_type <> 'TRIP' AND (oa.document_type <> 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' OR oa.effective_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED')) AND ( ( normalized.interval_start < #{windowEndExclusive} AND normalized.interval_end > #{windowStart} ) OR ( oa.document_type = 'PUNCH_CORRECTION' AND COALESCE( normalized.interval_start, normalized.point_instant) >= #{windowStart} AND COALESCE( normalized.interval_start, normalized.point_instant) < #{windowEndExclusive} ) OR ( oa.document_type = 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' AND NULLIF(TRIM(oa.original_leave_serial), '') IS NULL AND normalized.point_instant > #{windowStart} AND normalized.point_instant < #{windowEndExclusive} ) OR ( oa.document_type = 'LEAVE_REVOCATION' AND oa.effective_status IN ('APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED') AND NULLIF(TRIM(oa.original_leave_serial), '') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ranked_document original JOIN normalized_attendance_record original_interval ON original_interval.normalized_attendance_record_id = original.normalized_attendance_record_id AND original_interval.validation_status = 'VALID' JOIN employee_match_decision original_match ON original_match.normalized_attendance_record_id = original.normalized_attendance_record_id AND original_match.match_status = 'MATCHED' WHERE original.version_rank = 1
AND original.document_type = 'LEAVE' AND original.effective_status IN ( 'APPROVED', 'MODIFIED', 'SUPPLEMENTED', 'PENDING') AND original.attendance_source_id = oa.attendance_source_id AND original_match.employee_id = match_decision.employee_id AND TRIM(original.leave_serial) = TRIM(oa.original_leave_serial) AND original_interval.interval_start < #{windowEndExclusive} AND original_interval.interval_end > #{windowStart} ) )
) AND ( oa.document_type <> 'OVERTIME' OR ( context.activation_decision = 'ACTIVATED' AND context.overtime_type IS NOT NULL ) ) ORDER BY employee.employee_number, normalized.interval_start, oa.source_business_key

WITH ledger_effect AS ( SELECT entry.time_account_id, COALESCE(original.entry_type, entry.entry_type) AS semantic_type, COALESCE(original.amount_hours, entry.amount_hours) AS semantic_amount_hours, entry.amount_hours, entry.sequence_no FROM time_account_ledger_entry entry LEFT JOIN time_account_ledger_entry original ON entry.entry_type = 'REVERSAL' AND original.time_account_ledger_entry_id = entry.reversal_of_entry_id WHERE entry.occurred_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND entry.time_account_id IN ( SELECT account.time_account_id FROM time_account account WHERE account.company_id = #{companyId} AND account.employee_id = #{employeeId} ) ), ledger_totals AS ( SELECT time_account_id, COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) AS max_sequence, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'OPENING' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'GRANT' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS granted_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'OVERTIME_CREDIT' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overtime_credit_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND semantic_amount_hours > 0 THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS manual_increase_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND semantic_amount_hours < 0 THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS manual_deduction_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'USE' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS used_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'EXPIRY' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expired_hours, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_type = 'RETURN' THEN amount_hours ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returned_hours FROM ledger_effect GROUP BY time_account_id ) SELECT account.time_account_id AS accountId, account.employee_id AS employeeId, assignment.assignment_id AS employmentAssignmentId, CASE account.account_type WHEN 'ANNUAL_LEAVE' THEN 'ANNUAL_LEAVE' WHEN 'TIME_OFF' THEN 'COMP_TIME' WHEN 'WORK_HOURS' THEN 'RECOGNIZED_OVERTIME' END AS accountType, COALESCE(totals.opening_hours, 0) AS openingHours, COALESCE(totals.granted_hours, 0) AS grantedHours, COALESCE(totals.overtime_credit_hours, 0) AS overtimeCreditHours, COALESCE(totals.manual_increase_hours, 0) AS manualIncreaseHours, -COALESCE(totals.used_hours, 0) AS usedHours, -COALESCE(totals.expired_hours, 0) AS expiredHours, COALESCE(totals.returned_hours, 0) AS returnedHours, -COALESCE(totals.manual_deduction_hours, 0) AS manualDeductionHours, CONCAT( 'TIME_ACCOUNT:', account.time_account_id, ':ASOF:S', COALESCE(totals.max_sequence, 0) ) AS ledgerVersion FROM time_account account JOIN employment_assignment assignment ON assignment.employment_period_id = account.employment_period_id AND assignment.employee_id = account.employee_id AND assignment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND assignment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} AND assignment.effective_from < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > #{periodStart} ) LEFT JOIN ledger_totals totals ON totals.time_account_id = account.time_account_id WHERE account.company_id = #{companyId} AND account.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND account.account_year = YEAR(#{periodStart}) AND account.created_at <= #{dataAsOf} ORDER BY account.employee_id, account.account_type, account.time_account_id
